title: Khadgar, Garona, and the Ring
summary: On alternate Draenor, Khadgar's legendary-ring campaign intersects with Garona's control and Gul'dan's Shadow Council.
opening: An assassin's attack revealed another will behind it. Khadgar's search for the truth carried the campaign deeper into the Shadow Council's plans.
reviewNote: This is alternate Draenor. Verify the full ring questline and do not merge this Garona's sequence with main-timeline history. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Establish her attempted assassination of Khadgar. Follow Khadgar's attempt to break the control. Investigate the infiltrated stronghold and the artifact sought there. Connect the discovery to the legendary ring and the assault on Gul'dan's plans.

chapters.title: Garona's attack
chapters.body: Garona’s attempt upon Khadgar’s life revealed the pressure of another will. The danger reached beyond the assassin who stood before him.

chapters.title: A mind held captive
chapters.body: Khadgar sought to break that control. The campaign’s purpose now included a life bound to the Shadow Council’s designs.

chapters.title: Inside the Shadow Council
chapters.body: The search entered a guarded stronghold and turned toward an artifact hidden within it. Discovery demanded passage into the enemy’s own power.

chapters.title: The wider campaign
chapters.body: The findings joined the legendary ring’s history to the struggle against Gul’dan’s plans. The final course remains unfinished here.
